newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-E to issue up to $40 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-E to issue up to $40 mln bonds.

text.p: Polish construction and trading company Mostostal Export SA plans to issue up to 40,000 convertible bonds at a par value of $1,000, the company said in a statement on Friday.

Mostostal said it also planned to issue shares to be exchanged for the bonds with maturity of up to five years, but it said a final decision would be taken by the general shareholders' meeting on June 14. It said the bonds' coupon has yet to be set.
It said conversion price would be the average 10-session market price before the agreement with the issue underwriters was signed plus a margin, to be set later.
